name: NYC City Planning open datasets
capabilities: Official planning resource pages and NYC Open Data identify zoning-map dataset catalogs.
Candidate bounded query subset: Quartersection_ZoningMapIndex dataset wwcv-s7e7, whose public catalog page was captured; no dataset rows queried.

query.authentication: SODA documentation allows lower-limit anonymous2.x requests;3.0 requires token/user authentication. Neither API version requested here.
query.cost: No account, token or fee used; current anonymous quota not numerically specified.
query.supported_modes: SODA2.1 select/where/system :id are documented; target schema/availability still needs current API confirmation.
unsupported_modes: API queries while robots policy unavailable
Treating a map index as an authoritative tax-lot zoning determination
Current zoning rights inferred from an old index/map

licensing: NYC.gov general terms reserve rights; third-party/data-specific rights need reconciliation. Search discovery reports dataset license unspecified; this is not current API/license verification. Municipal material is not automatically federal public-domain content.
limitations: Latest data.cityofnewyork.us robots check returned503; requests deferred without alternative host/proxy.
Official DCP resources rendered navigation only in staticHTML and anonymousWebKit.
Search snippets supplied candidate dataset IDs and DCP attribution; direct page confirms title only. Row IDs, release/version and metadata rights remain unverified.
Map-index dataset, zoning feature dataset and downloadable maps are different records of the same catalog/operator, not independent origins.
next_action: Defer API requests until NYC Open Data robots policy recovers from the latest503. Then verify the published SODA2.1 map-index schema,10 exact section/native-row examples, paging/empty/error tests and current map access/rights. Do not use SODA3 without its required token; no accounts or bypasses. Continue independent sources.
